about: How a person's own circumstances, read from the records the engines keep, move their stance on a policy question beyond their lean, faith and degree (owner, Nov 14: build the simulation so it simulates these things; Account lead ruling: a view comes from the person's own simulated life). Each fact is measured against the world's own share (or mean) over the adults whose stances are counted, full people and counted residents alike, read monthly (stakeReferences in src/core2/life-stakes.ts, kept on the views engine's stakeReferences row): a renter in a world of owners stands further from the middle than a renter in a world of renters. A fact the records do not hold for a person adds nothing. How strongly the person weighs their own stake follows their traits (decision views.own-stake). Values are on the views scale (-1 to 1) per unit of the fact.

lifeEvents.about: The events on which a full person's circumstances change and their stance is told the same day (the stance listeners: interest-group membership follows the view): a job lost, a home bought, an eviction, a birth in the household. Every other change (a hire, a lease, a health plan, a child turning 6, the income fifth) is told at the first of the month, when the views engine reads again everyone whose circumstances it has read.

workingFrom.citation: The youngest age the work and health-plan facts are read at (BLS CPS table 3 rows 18 and 19 and up; NHIS 2023 adults 18 to 64).

workingTo.citation: Medicare age (42 U.S.C. 1395c): the end of the age band the work and health-plan facts are read at (18 to 64).

youngChildUnder.citation: The young-child age: families with own children under 6 (BLS, Employment Characteristics of Families, table 4).

rents.about: 1 when the person's household rents its home (a lease on the books for a full household; tenure rent for a counted one), else 0.

incomeFifth.about: The national household-income fifth of the person's household, 0 (lowest) to 4 (highest), from the readers the crime, health and school engines use (fullHouseholdIncomes; residents' householdIncome).

noWork.about: For an adult 18 to 64: 1 with no open job or work commitment, else 0 (for a counted household, its working-age members working outside a recorded job are counted as working). Others hold no such fact (null), which adds nothing.

noPrivatePlan.about: For an adult 18 to 64: 1 with no private health plan on the coverage engine's records (for a counted household, the share of its members under 65 its plan does not cover), else 0. Others hold no such fact (null), which adds nothing.

youngChild.about: 1 when a child under 6 lives in the person's household, else 0.

publicWorker.about: 1 when the person works for a government (an employer whose class is a public employer's, src/core2/public-pay-floor.ts), else 0.
